select i.id as id, i.sale_order_id as saleOrderId, i.rabbit_id as rabbitId, r.cage_id as cageId, r.type as type, r.gender as gender, i.weight as weight, i.price as price from sale_order_items i inner join sale_orders o on o.id = i.sale_order_id left join rabbits r on r.id = i.rabbit_id where o.house_id = #{houseId} and i.sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId} order by i.id asc
